References / Poster / 98

100% ElectroniCON flyer

The announcement flyer for the first vaporwave festival: a line-up in black grotesque type on a soft green-to-blue-to-violet radial gradient.

Source
DoNYC event listing
Creator
100% Electronica
Made
May 2019 (first announcement); festival August 31, 2019
Style
Vaporwave (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Hazy, warm, nostalgic
Evidence
The only copy found is the 700 × 700 flyer image on the DoNYC listing, below the size needed to observe it. The description below comes from that small copy and should be checked against a larger one.
Reviewed
28 September 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

Wikipedia: George Clanton “organized the first-ever vaporwave festival, 100% ElectroniCON, in New York City” in 2019, where Saint Pepsi, Vaperror, Nmesh, 18 Carat Affair, and Clanton performed. Wikipedia: Vaporwave.

The FADER reports 22 artists and more than 1,300 fans at Elsewhere, Brooklyn, a cardboard Keanu Reeves in a 100% Electronica T-shirt at the entrance, and “decorations inspired by memes.” The FADER, September 4, 2019.

Why it belongs

In the small copy, a hazy radial gradient from lime green to blue to violet sits behind curved black line-up text and a small wave-and-cube logo. It suggests that the gradient is the most durable part of the look.
